focus.label: Idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia (ICL) as the underlying cause
focus.why: Current frontier (node-14, 'Pneumocystis pneumonia in a non-HIV immunocompromised host with CD4 lymphocytopenia') identifies the immunodeficiency but not its cause; the belief states 'the main uncertainty is the underlying cause of the CD4 lymphocytopenia.' Node-3 and node-11 document no apparent immunosuppressive risk factors, no drugs, and negative HIV testing, and node-13 shows CD4 110 cells/µL with inverted CD4:CD8 0.35 — the classic profile of ICL, a diagnosis of exclusion and the most common recognized cause of non-HIV PCP.
